Read CLAUDE.md, docs/CONVENTIONS.md and the app.md of each app you touch before code. CLAUDE.md section 11 applies in full (production build, passkey sign-in, api-guard, no mocks, extend seed_e2e). Carry-over (integration notes): b884886 stopped one query (the interface-language list) reading after sign-out, and b25aba5 made the journeys wait; the race itself remains. In production a screen still loading when a person signs out (Today's GET /home and briefing reads) asks the server after the session has ended and meets a 401. useSignOut (features/identity/hooks.ts ~172) clears the query cache only when the call settles, and SessionGate (components/shell/SessionGate.tsx, 46 lines) keeps rendering the screens until the session read says anonymous. 1. Give the sign-out mutation a mutation key and have SessionGate render its loading state (the same 'shell.loading' status) while that mutation is pending (useIsMutating), so every screen unmounts and its queries stop before the session ends. 2. useSignOutToSignIn (components/shell/AccountMenu.tsx ~64-71), which the rail's menu and the More sheet share, redirects to /sign-in in a per-call mutate() onSettled. TanStack Query drops per-call callbacks once the calling component unmounts, and with the gate taking the shell down that redirect would never run. Move the redirect where it survives the unmount (the mutation's own options), and update shell.test.tsx, which mocks useSignOut. 3. Component tests: a pending sign-out shows no children; a settled one redirects to /sign-in even when the menu that started it has unmounted. 4. Run the journeys that sign out (identity J-1, navigation 'signing out works from More', and the others b884886 lists) and keep their waits: removing a wait is not part of this fix.
